description: Create PDF files from a validated JSON document, and look up the verified TerraPDF C# API while writing code.
name: io.github.sahebansari/terrapdf

environmentVariables.name: TERRAPDF_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory where create_pdf writes PDF files. Defaults to ./pdf-output.

environmentVariables.name: TERRAPDF_ASSET_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory that image and font paths resolve against. Defaults to the working directory.
